topic: What does recent independent evidence say about grid-scale lithium-ion battery degradation, lifecycle emissions and recycling? Distinguish commercial deployments from laboratory results.
Under what climate, electricity-price and building conditions do residential heat pumps reduce energy use and operating costs? Include counterexamples and regional differences.
What do reproducible studies show about security defects in AI-generated code, and which interventions demonstrably reduce them? Separate controlled studies from vendor claims.

What do systematic reviews and randomized trials report about mindfulness-based interventions for chronic pain? Distinguish effect size, evidence certainty and adverse-event reporting; this is literature research, not treatment advice.
How are widely used open-source projects measuring maintainer sustainability and funding? Compare primary survey methodology, foundation reports and contrary evidence.
How is data-center water consumption measured, and why do published estimates differ? Compare direct and indirect water, geographic constraints and disclosed limitations.
What can public filings, trade statistics and technical reports establish about the concentration of the solar photovoltaic supply chain? State time periods and distinguish manufacturing stages.

How did the publicly documented GitHub Actions artifact retention policy and defaults evolve? Look for archived documentation and dated announcements, and distinguish missing evidence from confirmed changes.
What does public evidence show about the lifecycle cost and emissions of battery, hydrogen and overhead-electric regional trains? Compare actual deployments and study assumptions.

How have official agencies and independent researchers evaluated the effectiveness of multilingual disaster-warning communication? Include evidence from more than one region and identify evaluation gaps.

How have preregistration, registered reports and multi-laboratory replication changed the evidence around social-psychology replication? Trace primary studies, criticism and methodological uncertainty.

What can public search results and reachable official onion-service pages establish about onion-service publication practices? Avoid private services, authentication, alleged leaks and speculative attribution. Clearly identify unreachable services.
